subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add true soft-steer semantics beyond current boundary steering, and should that be an opt-in queue mode or policy rather than a change to the existing steer default?
rationale: Current source and docs prove the requested behavior is not fully implemented, but the fix changes compatibility-sensitive run lifecycle, transcript state, tool-result pairing, and channel expectations, so maintainer product intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
options.body: Add a new mode or explicit policy for abort/capture/inject/resume while preserving documented boundary steering as the default.

options.title: Keep Boundary Steering Only
options.body: Decide current steer remains a model-boundary feature and narrow or close this broad feature after active-run ingress fixes settle.

options.title: Change Steer Globally
options.body: Make existing steer more aggressive by default, accepting compatibility risk for workflows that depend on current boundary behavior.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
recommendation.body: Add a new mode or explicit policy for abort/capture/inject/resume while preserving documented boundary steering as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: They already framed this as a product/runtime lifecycle decision and have adjacent review context on the steering docs and runtime contracts.
